newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CPC Int'l cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CPC Int'l cut.

text.p: -- Bankers Trust said analyst John O'Neil downgraded CPC International Inc to market perform from buy.
-- reduced the earnings estimates to $4.30 per share from $4.55 for 1997, and to $4.60 from $5.05 for 1998.
-- cited significantly lower corn refining margins as well as lack of capacity utilization, suggesting it could take a few years until demand catches up with supply.
-- does not see any catalysts on the horizon to drive the stock higher. Shares gained one to 76-7/8.
